question: In a certain code language, 'TOP' is coded as '102' and 'BAD' is coded as '14'. How will 'DOG' be coded in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : (2) is multiplied by the sum of the position values of all the letters according to the English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• 'TOP' is coded as '102'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8b89b80dd134fac25508d025a6a79c270d5476ea16c0d8264e4626763581d7b.png] 

​And,

 
• 'BAD' is coded as '14'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/93630f51842965293554b1d05967298d471f2452c0c40767aaafdebf2040c49b.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'DOG' is coded as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/328424f57362bcd7eaf45dc80a061e97c4734ae99c3ac14d667c295f20ffa898.png] 

Hence, "52" is the correct answer.
